verdicts.reason: Both scramble the content: the flavour names run together ('Cucumber Mint Blood Orange' crammed against the Build Your Pack button), 'Honey Rosemary' sits under the headline as if it were a subhead, the descriptors ('Warm & herbal', 'Bright & zesty', 'Cool & crisp') float away from their flavours, and the fine print is as big as the copy. A is worse because two of the cans have shrunk to specks next to the Online Only badge on the far right and 'Cool & crisp' is unreadably small; B at least keeps all three cans together on the left, though they are still mismatched sizes and none has its flavour label.
